svg.text: "The most beautiful things happen when you set your spirit free."

foreignObject.div: Born 22 December 1994 in Kandy, Sri Lanka. Singer, composer and songwriter — widely regarded as one of the most popular artists in Sri Lanka. Graduate of the University of Peradeniya with a B.Sc. in Electrical & Electronic Engineering.

Self-taught guitarist. Writes lyrics and melodies simultaneously — they arrive together, never one before the other. A singer, painter, dancer and storyteller. Entered the mainstream with his 2018 breakthrough "Pandama."

svg.text: BORN 22 DEC 1994 · KANDY, SRI LANKA · ENGINEER TURNED ARTIST · ACTIVE SINCE 2016 · VIDYARTHA COLLEGE · KINGSWOOD COLLEGE · UNIVERSITY OF PERADENIYA · SELF-TAUGHT GUITARIST · PAINTER · DANCER
Every song a story. Every story, a world.
